query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T08:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T12:00:00.000Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY destination.ip, destination.port, zeek.ssh.client, zeek.ssh.auth.success, zeek.ssh.algorithm.cipher, zeek.ssh.algorithm.mac
| SORT events DESC, last_seen DESC
